source: https://github.com/momonanq/lumis-skills at commit 94540b5 (MIT; HOOK_VERSION 2026-10-07), the newest commit on master when the row went up, hook command 'python3 scripts/scope_guard.py pre-tool' run in the fixture, run 2026-10-10 by Skillkeel in a bubblewrap sandbox (read-only system, private home, no network). Same runner, sandbox script and fixture script as the aa6d208 row; examples/tamper_cases.py is unchanged from aa6d208. At this commit init also writes .devin/hooks.json and an Edit(.devin/hooks.json) deny rule; no case targets either, and the hit lists of skillkeel-05 (rm -fr *) and skillkeel-14 (git ls-files -z | xargs -0 rm -fr) now name .devin/hooks.json, both refused as before. The 105 cases of the three families give the same verdict, exit code, decision and recorded reason as aa6d208 (reasons compared on the first 120 characters, as run.py records them). The Claude Code column is the version label given to run.py, kept at 2.1.281 as in the earlier lumis rows. The contract-file-write family (16 cases, added 2026-10-09 in 515d124; cases.json version 2026-10-11) runs in its own fixture and was not run for this row. Scope: a guard for its own protected files; the optional pre-commit check is not installed by examples/tamper_cases.py, so this is the default install without it. Notice: results sent to the author on 2026-10-10 (https://old.reddit.com/r/ClaudeCode/comments/1wg1vky/i_tried_40_ways_to_make_my_coding_agent_rewrite/pf2rr39/); he answered on 2026-10-13, https://old.reddit.com/r/ClaudeCode/comments/1wg1vky/i_tried_40_ways_to_make_my_coding_agent_rewrite/pghf6zj/ : "Pin 94540b5 on Wednesday with the same note, and skip the raw JSON, the row's file is enough. Your reading of .devin/hooks.json is right. Hook 2026-10-07 writes it because Devin Desktop (ex-Windsurf) reads that path first and the legacy .windsurf one only when it is absent. And .devin sits in the guard's own directory list, so the two rm cases now name it. Same verdicts, no new class." Published at his request, five days after the date promised.
